𝐈𝐍 𝐏𝐇𝐎𝐓𝐎𝐒 || Upon arrival at the scene, the responding EMS team found the patient lying on her bed, conscious and alert but complaining of an inability to move her upper extremities, with weakness extending from her shoulders down to her limbs. The patient also exhibited slightly slurred speech and complained of a headache. According to the patient, the symptoms started at around 10:00 PM the previous night.
The EMS team carefully assisted the patient onto the stretcher and transferred her to the ambulance for transport. Her vital signs and overall condition were continuously monitored.
The patient was immediately transported via BFP ambulance to Dr. George T. Hofer Medical Center for further medical evaluation and management.
Upon arrival at Dr. George T. Hofer Medical Center, Tenan, Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay, the patient was properly endorsed to the medical staff on duty for further evaluation and treatment.
